name: Report Data 4
definition: Numerical representation of the nett increases and decreases in an account at a specific point in time. A cash balance is calculated from a sum of cash credits minus a sum of cash debits.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Identification of the report as assigned by the sender.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Value date for which the pay-in schedule is generated.

DateAndTimeStamp.name: Date And Time Stamp
DateAndTimeStamp.definition: Date and time on which the report is generated. The offset with UTC may also be specified.

ScheduleType.name: Schedule Type
ScheduleType.definition: Defines the schedule timing that is, whether it is an initial or a revised schedule.

SettlementSessionIdentifier.name: Settlement Session Identifier
SettlementSessionIdentifier.definition: To indicate the requested CLS Settlement Session that the related trade is part of.
